description: A blank panel that animates every cable in the patch with the voltage running through it, and draws a scope for the cable under the pointer
notes: everything this module does is on its right-click menu. It has no jacks and nothing on the panel can be clicked.
the settings here apply to every cable in the patch, not to any cable of its own.
the scope of a cable is drawn while the pointer rests on either of the jacks it is patched to.
only the first of these modules in a patch has any effect; a second one draws nothing.
menu: Panel: City pigeon, Wild pigeon, Pigeon gang, Pigeon Army (loops) — chooses the picture printed on the panel
Cable animation enabled — turns the whole cable animation on and off
Cable led — leaves the plug at each end of a cable hollow so the voltage can light it, rather than filling it with the cable colour
Cable brightness — dims the cable colours with Rack's own room brightness setting
Cable polyphonic thickness — draws a polyphonic cable thicker than a monophonic one
Cable polyphonic: 1st channel, Sum, Sum / channel count — chooses which voltage of a polyphonic cable the animation follows
Cable CPU fast — uses a cheaper way of picking the voltage to draw, which costs less processor time
Cable slew — smooths how quickly the animation follows a change in voltage
Cable scale — sets how far the animation moves for a given voltage
Scope enabled — turns the hover scope on and off
Scope on MAJ — shows the scope only while the shift key is held down
Scope display circular — draws the scope as a circle rather than a straight trace
Scope position: Top left, Top right, Bottom left, Bottom right, Center — chooses where on screen the scope is drawn
Scope scale — sets the size of the scope
Scope thickness — sets the thickness of the scope trace
Scope background alpha — sets how opaque the scope's background is
Scope voltage alpha — sets how opaque the voltage figure drawn on the scope is
Scope label alpha — sets how opaque the label naming the cable's two ends is
Scope alpha — sets how opaque the whole scope is
